shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,340p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then echo REANCHOR_PRESENT; fi"
